name: Commerce VictoriaBank Moldova
description: Off-site Drupal Commerce payment gateway for VictoriaBank (Moldova): redirects the shopper to VictoriaBank's hosted card page and verifies the bank's RSA-signed callback before creating/advancing the Commerce payment. Amounts are in MDL.
project_description:
This module integrates the VictoriaBank Gateway API with Drupal Commerce.

 Installation 
 
 Contact a VictoriaBank manager to receive integration instructions. 
 Generate your own public/private key pair. 
 Create a folder named vicb_pem inside your private file system: private://vicb_pem . 
 Copy the following files to the vicb_pem folder:
 
 key.pem 
 pubkey.pem 
 victoria_pub.pem 
 
 
 Create and configure the new payment gateway in Drupal Commerce. 
 
 Callback URL: https://yourdomain.com/commerce-vb-md/callback 

 Minimum Requirements 
 Requires Drupal Commerce Core version 3.x
